title: Require verifiable evidence integrity for architecture proposals
observed_facts: A controlled repository evidence target exists for validating evidence integrity checks.
This fixture supports testing the proposal gate's content-hash validation; it does not prove production recovery behavior.
hypothesis: A shared pair identifier plus direct graph bindings makes recovery deterministic and exposes stale or missing links earlier.
counterexamples: The failed recovery run is a counterexample to inferring identity from nearby prose.
A mismatched pair ID must be detected as PARTIAL rather than silently recovered.
proposed_change: Require a repository-confined evidence locator and exact SHA-256 before a proposal can be considered reviewable.
rollback_plan: Revert the isolated prototype or the specific approved commit; preserve the failed-run evidence.
